scope: A monotonic commit interlock shared by each actual CognitiveStore writer pool and all its clones after an uncertain started Objective checkpoint exchange. This does not install a protected Current coordinator or authenticate a Root.

interfaces.change: None; original default semantics and bytes retained.
interfaces.claim: No new hook is silently applied to unrelated state callers.

interfaces.change: Explicit caller supplies the real synchronous commit predicate; after_connect installs it on every physical connection. No empty before_checkout callback and no claim of Current coordination.
interfaces.gate: Actual explicit and implicit SQLite commit veto. Same WAL/FULL/foreign-key/max5/busy5s settings.

interfaces.change: Share only the physical hook-install helper with the new guarded API; retain new/reused async coordination and its existing lock ordering.
interfaces.gate: R2c four physical controls and original state suite remain required.

interfaces.change: Create one per-pool gate before opening. Explicitly use guarded pool. Every clone and later physical replacement shares the same gate.
interfaces.preserve: Legacy initialization remains legacy; shared open guard, private Windows directory handle, validation, migration, path and sync helpers retained.

interfaces.change: The candidate-validation pool and checkpoint/reopened active pool both receive the same per-attempt gate.
interfaces.preserve: Original retained source, exact current-cut verification, exclusive original open guard, pointer publication, cleanup and Windows helpers stay unchanged.

interfaces.change: Release the existing read-only BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with rollback after exact capture.
interfaces.reason: The real SQLite commit hook applies to an empty write transaction too; a pure readback must not masquerade as a new commit.
interfaces.preserve: Same original lock, same capture and exact return value; no new witness.

interfaces.change: Create an RAII attempt after existing cut capture and live checks, immediately before the independent ACK future. A complete exact ACK plus final live check acknowledges the attempt; any error, mismatch, timeout or cancellation thereafter permanently fences pool commits before caller transaction drop.
interfaces.preserve: Invalid deadline, authority failure or cancellation before this point does not newly fence; original error types and at-most-5s cooperative ACK deadline unchanged. Later successful ACK never resets the gate.

interfaces.change: No public API deletion or early global fence rejection. Read-only re-acknowledgement uses the same original SQL transaction and independent provider.
interfaces.preserve: Existing refusal/timeout/mismatch/revocation then explicit read-ACK tests remain byte-identical.

interfaces.change: No source behavior change beyond actual pool interlock.
interfaces.preserve: Existing duplicate detection still returns AlreadyRetained before attempted commit. A fresh insertion after fencing cannot actually commit; the existing AcknowledgementUnknown mapping remains.

interfaces.change: Internal typed Existing/Inserted result; only the original exact duplicate branch returns Existing. Caller rolls back Existing and commits Inserted, then runs the same independent ACK.
interfaces.preserve: All original capacity, exact bytes, event-chain, authority, cancellation and conflict checks remain. Re-acknowledging an existing local cancellation must not invoke an empty COMMIT after fencing or rearm any permission.

interfaces.interface: Objective sender read / local tickets / production authority
interfaces.change: Read methods, original ticket states, public sender signature and original authority verifier remain unchanged in this first cohort.
interfaces.limit: This cohort does not claim that all external-effect admission paths are protected Current-aware; it proves commits through the retained pool are vetoed. It does not mint/revoke Root authority.

sqlite.finding: Any SQLITE_TXN_WRITE sets needXcommit, including BEGIN IMMEDIATE with no new rows; nonzero callback returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_COMMITHOOK.

sqlx.finding: The locked handle safely installs the actual SQLite commit hook; false means veto.

preservation: All original Objective sender test files and assertions byte-identical.
All current Windows retained directory, private-state open/prepare/validate/pointer/sync source preserved.
No Agentd main, generic AgentdProductionHostAttachment<C>.original_sender, ordinary peer/current-user admission, authority credential conversion, dependencies or refs changed.
not_solved: Another independently opened legacy shared CognitiveStore instance has its own pool; this interlock is not a cross-process or durable publisher fence.
Protected Current coordinator, receipt CAS, consuming exclusive binder and all observer/barrier routing remain separate follow-up work.
R1 synchronous preflight and R2a Tokio registration are separate phases; no caller composition is claimed.
No new source has been formatted, compiled or executed.
